info.title: Postroom API
info.description: REST/JSON under /api for the Postroom webmail. Generated from the zod schemas that validate requests (PST-REQ-085); regenerate with `pnpm --filter @postroom/api openapi`.

highestModseq.description: A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.
A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.

html.description: The HTML part exactly as sent. NOT sanitised: render it only on the usercontent origin (PST-T-3.12).

modseq.description: A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.
A MODSEQ (RFC 7162), as a decimal string.

url.description: The sanitised message on the usercontent origin: frame it with sandbox (no allow-scripts, no allow-same-origin). A capability; expires at expiresAt.

images.description: Whether remote images load (through the proxy) in this render.

remoteImages.description: Remote images in the message. Above 0 with images false means some are blocked.

get.description: Starts with one mailbox.changed per mailbox, then message.new (MessageNewEvent) and mailbox.changed (MailboxChangedEvent) as mail arrives or changes. A comment heartbeat every 25 s. Only the caller's mailboxes.

get.summary: One page of a mailbox, newest UID first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

schema.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

200.description: A page; nextCursor is null on the last.

404.description: Not a mailbox of the caller.

get.summary: One message: summary, threading headers and verdict.

404.description: Not a message of the caller.

patch.summary: Add/remove flags and/or move to another mailbox.
patch.description: Requires If-Match with the ETag from GET. A move creates the message in the target with a new UID (and a new id), removes it from the source, and bumps both mailboxes' HIGHESTMODSEQ. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the version being changed, or *.

items.description: A system flag (\Seen, \Answered, \Flagged, \Draft) or an IMAP keyword atom.
A system flag (\Seen, \Answered, \Flagged, \Draft) or an IMAP keyword atom.

mailboxId.description: Move the message to this mailbox (one of the caller’s own).

200.description: The message after the change (a new id after a move).

404.description: Not a message (or target mailbox) of the caller.

412.description: If-Match is stale; the current ETag is returned.

get.summary: One MIME leaf part, decoded and streamed as a download (never inline).

200.description: application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition: attachment; the declared type is in X-Postroom-Content-Type.

404.description: No such message or leaf part.

get.summary: The parsed message: headers, text, raw html and the attachment list.

404.description: Not a message of the caller.

get.summary: The RFC 5322 source, streamed as a text/plain download.

404.description: Not a message of the caller.

get.summary: A short-lived URL of the sanitised HTML on the usercontent origin (PST-REQ-081).
get.description: The usercontent origin has no session cookie, so this mints a capability for one message of the caller, under the caller's session, valid for 15 minutes. Remote images stay blocked unless images=1, and then load only through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082). Frame the URL with sandbox and no allow-scripts/allow-same-origin.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: 1 = the reader chose to load remote images, through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082).

schema.description: 1 = the reader chose to load remote images, through the image proxy (PST-REQ-082).

404.description: Not a message of the caller.

get.summary: Full-text search over the caller’s mail (PST-REQ-080).

delete.summary: Remove the bucket pin for this sender (a screen decision, if any, is unaffected).

get.summary: The caller's pin for this sender address, if any (PST-REQ-105).

200.description: The pin (bucket is null when there is none).

put.summary: Pin this sender to a bucket — overrides the classifier for their mail (PST-REQ-105).
put.description: A pin into Priority or People still requires the message to authenticate, exactly like the VIP rule. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

post.summary: Answer this sender's new-sender badge: Allow or Block (PST-REQ-106).
post.description: Allow treats the sender as a known contact, so a directly-addressed message from them can reach Priority. Block routes their future mail to Junk. Either clears the $NewSender badge on their already-filed mail. Audited. Needs x-postroom-csrf: 1.

200.description: The screen decision after the change.

get.summary: A thread and the caller's messages in it, oldest first.

404.description: Not a thread of the caller.
